correctness.rationale: TARGET-route disproof audited directly. Lemma 1: sigma_N^2=1-3^{-1/2}/B_N->1 verified by Pareto second-moment integral 3*t0^3/B with t0=1/sqrt(3); clip/condition variants are O(1/B)->1, correct. Lemma 2 at beta0=3/5: B_N/(sigma sqrtN)=N^{0.1}->inf so threshold t=K'sigma sqrtN<B_N eventually; p_N=c_*(t^{-3}-B_N^{-3}); M=N(N-1)/2 gives M p_N >= const*N^{1/2}(1-r_N)->inf with r_N=(t/B_N)^3~N^{-0.3}->0, so (1-p_N)^M<=exp(-Mp_N)->0. Clip/condition lower bounds correct (clip superset, condition denominator->1). Lemma 3: N*c_*(sigma sqrtN)^{-3}=O(N^{-1/2})->0, correct; fixed-law diagonal alternative correct. Spectral step lambda_max>=max|Hij|-max|Hkk| via v=(e_i+s e_j)/sqrt2 verified. Hence P(lambda_max>=K)->1 for every fixed K, so P(N^{2/3}(lambda-2)<=s)->0 while TW1 F1(s) in (0,1) for all s (full support on R). Tight-limit exclusion at any fixed centering follows. Conventions (zero-fill/clip/condition) all covered. Numerical artifact replayed independently: VERIFY_OK with Mp 0.6->374 and N=800 demo max|H|=1.96, lambda=2.50. No gap.

originality.rationale: Headline is a TARGET-route refutation: beta0=3/5<2/3 falsifies universal TW1 for every beta<2/3. Fused live retrieval (SerpBase 10 + OpenAlex 15 + Crossref 15 per query, 20 deduplicated, no partial failure) finds only untruncated Poisson theory (Soshnikov 2004, Auffinger-Ben Arous-Peche 2009), fixed-law TW criteria (Lee-Yin), and unrelated TW/spike work. No source states a truncated E3^{(beta)} family result at beta=3/5, a beta>1/2 divergence, or the N-dependent Lee-Yin failure at s~sqrtN. See decisive_checks for adversarial coverage tests. Method is elementary (union bound + 2x2 variational principle) but the instantiated falsifying datum for this named family and exponent is not previously recorded, and no prior stronger theorem implies it.

value.rationale: Refutation is independently retrievable: it falsifies the admitted sharp beta_c=2/3 diagram as stated (not merely unproved), blocks the false practitioner recipe 'cut below N^{2/3} to recover TW' (N^{0.6} still diverges), diagnoses the N-dependent misuse of fixed-law Lee-Yin (s^4P(|y|>s) diverges like sqrtN at s~sqrtN), and locates the true single-entry TW threshold at <=1/2 with an explicit intermediate (1/2,2/3) phase where neither half holds. Honestly scoped (Poisson half untouched, corrected diagram left open). This is a substantive calibration correction for a natural object, not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny gain, or unexplained enumeration.
